rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, a consumer-focused personal AI agent with brain-inspired memory systems, while Joseph has hands-on experience in robotics and autonomous systems from his time at Nupeak Robotics. Their complementary backgrounds in AI/software engineering and robotics-manipulation could spark ideas around embodied AI or intelligent agent applications beyond pure software.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Joseph Zheng — you're both early builders exploring AI and autonomous systems from different angles, and could brainstorm how personal AI agents might extend into robotics or physical interaction.
